Currently no uniform-per-area option. Increase point count for better coverage.

description: Creates a specified number of points randomly or in a pattern on the surface or within the volume of a mathematical shape (Sphere, Box, Torus, Tube, Rectangle, Circle, Line). Supports normal and tangent attributes with randomization.
